description: Chemical Guys Bug Remover, Sap & Tar Remover, Fast Acting Prewash Cleaner for Cars, Trucks & SUVs, Removes Stuck Debris, Road Film, Bug Splashes - Distributed/Packaged by Chemical Guys. Product Details: Insect splashes, tree sap, and tar stains can bond to your paint and glass quickly, especially after driving on the road. Insect, Sap & Tar Remover Spray is a pre-washed cleaner that helps break down stubborn residue so you can wash with less scrubbing and better results.Use it to target front bumpers, grilles, mirrors, windshields and bottom panels where road film and sticky build-up accumulate. The handy spray delivery establishes an even layer on problem areas, helping to loosen dirt and lift stuck in the mess before touching the surface with a wash mitt.For best results, work on a cool surface out of direct sun. Spray on the affected area from a short distance for full coverage, let the product stay briefly, then rinse thoroughly. Follow with your preferred car wash soap and a clean microfiber wash mitt to safely remove what has become loose.During heavy insect season or after long hauls, repeat on difficult spots as needed and rinse thoroughly between applications. Once cleaned, finish with your favorite wax or sealant to help make future cleaning easier and keep exterior surfaces looking their best.When used as directed, this formula is designed for common exterior materials including clear coat paint, glass, chrome and plastic trim. This soaking step supports a softer washing process and helps reduce the need for aggressive agitation in difficult spots.Whether you keep a daily driver, clean up after a road trip, or prepare a vehicle for a complete detail, bug, sap, and tar remover spray spray helps simplify exterior cleaning so your soap can work more effectively and your finish looks cleaner after every wash.
